# Skyscape Photography — Aerial Landscape Photography by Kshitiz Bathwal
> Fine art aerial landscape photography across India and global coastlines, flown between 30 and 299 metres above ground level (AGL).

## Artist & Pilot Overview
- **Photographer & Pilot:** Kshitiz Bathwal
- **Role:** Founder & Lead UAS Cinematographer, Software Engineer
- **Specialization:** Aerial Landscape Photography, Fine Art Archival Prints, Commercial Drone Cinematography
- **Territory:** India (14+ states documented) and global coastal/island geography (Mauritius, Bali)
- **Official Domain:** https://www.skyscapephoto.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/skyscape_photography/
- **Contact:** contact@skyscapephoto.com

## Technical & Telemetric Flight Specs
- **Flight Ceiling:** Flown strictly within DGCA regulations, holding up to 299 metres AGL
- **Primary Aircraft:** DJI Air 2S with 1-inch CMOS sensor
- **Optics & Recording:** 4K 60FPS in 10-bit D-Log colour profile
- **Flight Volume:** 342+ completed flight missions, 118+ flight hours, 1,624+ km flown over ground

## Core Portfolio Highlights
1. **Macondé Peak & Emerald Lagoon (Baie du Cap, Mauritius):** Volcanic basalt hairpin ridge meeting turquoise coral reef from 168m AGL.
2. **Kelingking T-Rex Cliff (Nusa Penida, Bali):** Limestone headland towering 200m over turquoise surf from 299m AGL.
3. **Mount Ijen Acidic Crater Lake (East Java):** World's largest acidic volcanic caldera lake with steaming solfataras from 212m AGL.
4. **Angel's Billabong (Nusa Penida):** Natural tidal infinity pool carved by ocean spindrift from 114m AGL.
5. **Om Beach & Sea Cliffs (Gokarna, Karnataka):** Sacred Om-shaped coastal coves and granite cliffs from 72m AGL.
6. **Manipal End Point (Karnataka):** Swarna river estuary channels and coastal plateau from 38m AGL.

- **Archival Fine Art Prints:** Available in limited editions on 100% cotton rag museum paper.
